title: message_filters TimeSynchronizer callback never called in ROS 2: exact stamps, slop, QoS, queue_size, scope and the Lyrical API changes, measured
excerpt: Why a message_filters TimeSynchronizer or ApproximateTimeSynchronizer callback never fires: stamps 1 ms apart, slop, best-effort QoS, queue_size vs lag, zero stamps, header-less types and C++ scope. Counted in rclpy and rclcpp on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical, plus Lyrical's C++ API breaks.
